sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Opening with the date of the maamar, 19 Kislev 5738.

translations.translation: B'Siyata Dishmaya.
19 Kislev 5738*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The redemption of 19 Kislev is connected to the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace," as explained by the Alter Rebbe.

translations.translation: "He redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me, for many were with me"1,
And it is known what was said by the Rebbe, the Alter Rebbe, author of the redemption, in his holy letter2
(regarding the redemption of 19 Kislev),
When I read in the book of Tehillim the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace,"
before I began the verse after it,
I went out in peace from the One of peace,
that his redemption is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace."
And from this it is understood also regarding the redemption of his son and successor, the Rebbe, the Mitteler Rebbe
(on 10 Kislev),
that it is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace"3,
for this verse is in the monthly portion of Tehillim for the tenth day of the month4.
[And one can connect this also with the length of the explanation etc. in his discourse beginning "He redeemed my soul in peace"5].
And also the redemption of 12 and 13 Tammuz of the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe,
their successor
(of the Alter Rebbe and the Mitteler Rebbe),
is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace"6,
as is also proven from the fact that several of the maamarim of 12 and 13 Tammuz7
begin with this verse.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection of redemption to "peace" is also related to the fact that the redemptions occurred on a third day or in a third month, as peace is associated with the third.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that this matter
[the connection of the redemption to "He redeemed my soul in peace"]
is also connected to the fact that the redemption of 19 Kislev was on the third day in which "it was good" was repeated8
[i.e., Tuesday]9
and in the third month
(of the winter months)10
[And also the redemption of 10 Kislev and of 12 Tammuz were on the third,
the redemption of 10 Kislev – in the third month,
and the redemption of 12 Tammuz – on the third day in which "it was good" was repeated],
for the main novelty in the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace" is
(not so much the matter of redemption,
but rather)
that the redemption is in peace11
and the third12
is the matter of peace13.
